section_en.title: Frequently Asked Questions
section_en.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Lovart's AI Food Truck Wrap Designer.

faq.question: How does Lovart's AI Food Truck Wrap Designer work?
faq.answer: Lovart uses its MCoT (Multi-step Chain of Thought) engine as your Creative Director. Describe your food truck — cuisine type, truck model, brand colors, and design preferences — and the AI generates a complete vehicle wrap design on the ChatCanvas. Vehicle Contour Adaptation automatically fits graphics to your truck's body lines. Use the 3D Smart Mockup to preview your design from every angle, Touch Edit to refine details, and export in 8K resolution (PNG/JPG/SVG/PSD) with panel-separated files ready for vinyl printing.

faq.question: Is Lovart free for truck wrap design?
faq.answer: Yes. Lovart provides free daily credits so you can try the AI Truck Wrap Designer at no cost. For food truck owners and fleet operators, choose from three plans: Starter ($20/month, 2,000 credits), Basic ($35/month, 3,500 credits), and Pro ($110/month, 11,000 credits). All paid plans include full commercial rights — you own your wrap design and can use it for any commercial purpose.

faq.question: What file formats can I export my truck wrap in?
faq.answer: Lovart supports 8K resolution export in PNG, JPG, SVG, and PSD formats. Files are auto-separated by vehicle panel (driver side, passenger side, rear, front, roof if applicable) with precise dimensions, bleed areas, and alignment marks for professional vinyl wrap installers. All formats are available on paid plans; free credits include watermarked previews.

faq.question: Does Lovart support my specific food truck model?
faq.answer: Lovart's Vehicle Contour Adaptation supports all major food truck and van models including Freightliner MT, Ford E-Series, Mercedes Sprinter, Ram ProMaster, Isuzu NPR, step vans, airstream trailers, and custom-built trucks. You can also upload your truck's measurements for custom contour mapping if your model isn't in the library.

faq.question: Do I own the commercial rights to my truck wrap design on paid plans?
faq.answer: Yes. All truck wrap designs created on paid plans (Starter, Basic, Pro) come with full commercial rights. You own the design and can print, install, and use it commercially without restriction. Designs generated with free daily credits are for evaluation only and may not be used commercially.

faq.question: What makes Lovart's truck wraps suitable for outdoor use?
faq.answer: Lovart's Weather-Resistant Color engine optimizes every design for outdoor durability. It uses UV-resistant color profiles tested against 5–7 years of sun exposure, ensures high contrast visibility in both direct sunlight and overcast conditions, and maintains legibility of text (menu items, phone numbers) from 50+ feet away. Output files meet professional cast vinyl printing specifications.

faq.question: Can I preview my design on a 3D model before printing?
faq.answer: Yes, this is one of Lovart's most powerful features for vehicle wraps. The Smart Mockup module places your design on an interactive 3D model of your truck. You can rotate the model 360°, zoom into panel seams and wheel well contours, and view the wrap from street level, service side, and rear angles. This eliminates costly print errors — if it looks right on the 3D model, it will look right on the truck.

faq.question: How long does it take to design a food truck wrap?
faq.answer: Most users generate their first concept in 60–90 seconds. Refining with Vehicle Contour Adaptation, 3D Smart Mockup preview, and Touch Edit typically takes 30–45 minutes for a complete, print-ready wrap. Compare this to traditional design agencies who typically take 2–4 weeks and charge $1,500–$4,000 for the same deliverable. Lovart's Pro plan handles this for $110/month.

faq.question: How does Lovart compare to hiring a professional vehicle wrap designer?
faq.answer: Professional vehicle wrap designers charge $1,500–$4,000 per truck with 2–4 week turnaround times. Lovart costs $20–$110/month flat with instant generation and unlimited revisions. Key advantages include: real-time 3D previews (agencies typically provide 2D mockups), Vehicle Contour Adaptation auto-fitting (manual measurement takes hours), Weather-Resistant Color optimization (most designers don't specialize in outdoor durability), and 8K panel-separated export files that installers prefer. For fleet operators with 3+ trucks, Lovart can reduce design costs by 97%+.

section_zh-TW.title: 常見問題
section_zh-TW.subtitle: 關於 Lovart AI 餐車包裝設計師，您想知道的都在這裡。

faq.question: Lovart AI 餐車包裝設計師如何工作？
faq.answer: Lovart 以 MCoT（多步思維鏈）引擎擔任您的創意總監。描述餐車——菜系、車型、品牌顏色、設計偏好——AI 即在 ChatCanvas 上生成完整車輛包裝。車身輪廓智能適配自動貼合車身線條。用 3D 智慧樣機從每個角度預覽設計，以 Touch Edit 微調細節，最終用 8K 解析度（PNG/JPG/SVG/PSD）按面板分離匯出，可直接交付乙烯基印刷。

faq.question: Lovart 餐車包裝設計免費嗎？
faq.answer: 完全免費！Lovart 提供每日免費額度，讓您零成本上手 AI 餐車包裝設計師。對於餐車店主與車隊運營商，可選三種付費方案：Starter（$20/月，2,000 積分）、Basic（$35/月，3,500 積分）和 Pro（$110/月，11,000 積分）。所有付費方案均包含完整商業使用權——您擁有設計版權，可將其用於任何商業用途。

faq.question: 餐車包裝可以匯出為哪些檔案格式？
faq.answer: Lovart 支援以 8K 解析度匯出 PNG、JPG、SVG、PSD 格式。檔案按車身面板自動分離（駕駛側、副駕側、尾部、車頭、車頂等），並附有精確尺寸、出血區域和對齊標記，方便專業貼膜安裝。所有格式在付費方案中可用；免費額度提供帶浮水印的預覽版。

faq.question: Lovart 支援我的具體餐車車型嗎？
faq.answer: Lovart 車身輪廓智能適配支援所有主流餐車與麵包車型號，包括 Freightliner MT、福特 E 系列、賓士 Sprinter、Ram ProMaster、五十鈴 NPR、步進式貨車、Airstream 拖車及客製改裝餐車。如您的車型不在庫中，也可上傳餐車尺寸數據，進行自訂輪廓映射。

faq.question: 付費方案下，我擁有餐車包裝的商業版權嗎？
faq.answer: 是的。所有在付費方案（Starter、Basic、Pro）下創建的餐車包裝設計均附帶完整商業使用權。您擁有設計，可自由印刷、安裝及商用，不受限制。使用每日免費額度生成的設計僅供評估，不可商用。

faq.question: Lovart 的餐車包裝為何適合戶外使用？
faq.answer: Lovart 耐候色彩引擎為每款設計優化戶外耐久性。採用經過 5-7 年日曬測試的抗紫外線色彩配置，確保在強烈陽光與陰天條件下均保持高對比度，菜單文字與電話號碼等從 50 英尺（約 15 公尺）外依然清晰可讀。輸出檔案符合專業鑄造級乙烯基印刷標準。

faq.question: 印刷前能否在 3D 模型上預覽設計？
faq.answer: 當然可以，這是 Lovart 在車輛包裝領域最強大的功能之一。智慧樣機模組將您的設計放在可交互的 3D 餐車模型上。您可以 360° 旋轉、放大面板接縫與輪拱輪廓，從街景、服務側和尾部角度審視包裝。徹底消除代價高昂的印刷錯誤——3D 模型上沒問題，實車上就沒問題。

faq.question: 設計一套餐車包裝需要多長時間？
faq.answer: 大多數用戶 60-90 秒即可生成首個概念。配合車身輪廓適配、3D 智慧樣機預覽與 Touch Edit 精細調整，通常 30-45 分鐘即可完成一套可交付印刷的完整包裝。而傳統設計公司通常需 2-4 週，收費 1,500-4,000 美元。Lovart 的 Pro 方案每月僅需 $110。

faq.question: Lovart 與聘請專業車輛包裝設計師相比如何？
faq.answer: 專業車輛包裝設計師每輛車收費 1,500-4,000 美元，交付週期 2-4 週。Lovart 僅需 $20-$110/月，即時生成且無限次修改。核心優勢：即時 3D 預覽（設計公司一般只提供 2D 樣稿）、車身輪廓自動適配（手動測量耗時數小時）、耐候色彩優化（多數設計師不專攻戶外耐久性）以及貼膜師傅青睞的 8K 按面板分離匯出檔案。對於擁有 3 輛以上餐車的車隊運營商，Lovart 可將設計成本降低 97% 以上。
